abstract: Gestational choriocarcinoma usually arises in the uterine cavity and is associated with coincident or antecedent pregnancy. Extrauterine choriocarcinomas are very rare entities, and most of these are located in the uterine cervix. In our case, a 43-year-old woman was admitted in our hospital because she had amenorrhea for 2 months and elevated serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin levels. The patient was considered to have an ectopic pregnancy. Initially, she was treated with methotrexate, but since there was a continuous rise in human chorionic gonadotropin levels, the patient underwent a laparoscopy, along with dilatation and curettage (D&C) of the uterine cavity. Histopathologic findings, including immunohistochemical study, led to the diagnosis of choriocarcinoma of the cervix. Finally, the patient underwent a transabdominal hysterectomy and received single agent chemotherapy with methotrexate. Our case represents a primary choriocarcinoma of the cervix, which was initially misdiagnosed as an ectopic pregnancy. The difficulties in differential diagnosis are discussed. Immunohistochemical evaluation remains the mainstay of the diagnosis in most cases. Choriocarcinoma has a very good prognosis even in advanced stages, since it is a very chemosensitive tumor.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌は通常子宮腔内に発生し、同時期または先行する妊娠と関連する。子宮外絨毛癌は非常に稀であり、そのほとんどは子宮頸部に発生する。本症例では、43歳女性が2か月間の無月経と血清β-hCG値の上昇のため当院を受診した。子宮外妊娠と考えられた。当初はメトトレキサートで治療されたが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値の持続的な上昇がみられたため、腹腔鏡検査および子宮腔の拡張掻爬術(D&C)が施行された。免疫組織化学染色を含む病理組織学的所見から、子宮頸部絨毛癌と診断された。最終的に経腹子宮全摘術を受け、メトトレキサートによる単剤化学療法を施行された。本症例は子宮頸部原発の絨毛癌であり、当初は子宮外妊娠と誤診された。鑑別診断の困難さについて考察する。免疫組織化学的評価は、ほとんどの症例で診断の主軸となる。絨毛癌は化学療法への感受性が非常に高く、進行期でも予後は良好である。
